train: Original train except all reserved localization workers; utterance, intent, BIO supervision; gold intent and BIO histories only during training
development: Original dev except all reserved workers; adaptive development, not a fresh reserve
reservation: Original test and all reserved workers unused until development gates justify a frozen audit
algorithm: Hashed averaged perceptron with teacher-forced legal BIO histories during training; greedy predicted histories during inference. Per-head proportional int8 quantization and magnitude pruning. No vocabulary or domain answers hardcoded.
change_hypothesis: Previous predicted histories made some gold I:role labels illegal in training, generating unavoidable errors. Public sequence v2 (clipping) and v3 (proportional quantization only) remain immutable negative controls; this protocol changes training history, not evaluation targets or acceptance gates.
selection: Exact structured dev matches, then fewer stored nonzero weights, then policy order
metrics: Exact intent and all ordered role/value spans; all errors and abstentions count. Margins are not probabilities or action authority.
completion_contract: evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json; every gate required before M1 or M2
scope: Known empirical method, not a novel AGI claim. pt-PT source and localizers do not establish general pt-BR understanding. Training scratch, unknown RSS and energy are not zero. Only raw id/text reach inference.
